g.text: A puzzle where you turn mirrors to bring
One evening the light doesn't come home. You turn
mirrors to guide the beam back. Each of ten worlds
teaches a new rule: splitters, colour filters, prisms,
lenses. Alongside 150 handmade levels there are daily…
